tasks.title: Announcement #40
tasks.instruction: Listen to a school radio announcement.
tasks.transcript: Attention students, We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent changes to our work study program application process. Unfortunately, due to system issues, some applications were not processed properly. We are working to resolve this problem as quickly as possible. Please resubmit your applications through the updated portal and phone the Career Center if you encounter any further issues. Additionally, we're pleased to announce several new part time work opportunities available on campus. Feel free to stop by the Center to learn more.

questions.stem: According to the announcement, what should students do with some applications?

options.A: Revise them to include personal recommendations
options.B: Resubmit them through a new system
options.C: Have them reviewed by university staff
options.D: Hold onto them until further notice

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：学生应该如何处理部分申请？ 定位原文：Please resubmit your applications through the updated portal 选项分析： A. 修改内容。未提及。 B. 重新提交。直接对应，因此正确。 C. 给工作人员审核。未提及。 D. 暂时保留。相反，应重新提交。

questions.stem: What new opportunity is being offered by the center?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：中心提供了什么新机会？ 定位原文：new part time work opportunities available on campus 选项分析： A. 简历培训。未提及。 B. 实习机会。未提及。 C. 延长咨询时间。未提及。 D. 校内兼职。直接对应，因此正确。
